data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Ownership-based allocation is net-beneficial: it systematically prunes the combinatorial explosion of rival-programme crossovers, and the resulting efficiency is a precondition\u2014rather than a barrier\u2014for discovering cross-cutting explanations, because cross-cutting explanations require high confidence in the source-programme facts being merged, which ownership best provides.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the same rival programme, once given ownership of a problem lineage, is empirically observed to block or delete references from other programmes (rather than merely failing to add them), the pruning mechanism has become a suppression mechanism.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If cross-cutting explanations that are generated by defectors (e.g. an ad-hoc aliasing of SRC_001 and SRC_003) are found to outperform owner-produced explanations on external tests, the pruning-via-efficiency defence fails.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If a non-owner programme had a verified source-memory claim that was structurally necessary to the parent artifact but was excluded by ownership routing, the precondition defence is refuted.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"A single reasoning system cannot run every rival hypothesis on every datum. Ownership assigns a problem to the lineage that produced the parent artifact, so that artefact's internal invariants (e.g. school-2 unifier consolidation of ba687c... mechanist outputs) carry forward with minimal friction. By localising search, the system quickly builds a high-confidence substrate within each programme. A cross-cutting explanation, when it does emerge, can then piggyback on the reliable substrate of each owner rather than being discovered by a globally random walk that would starve every programme. Suppression is therefore not systematic; it is an incidental cost of a precondition.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
